with machine/usb/control/request as UsbControlRequest

# Finite class policy state; no endpoint, address or authority facts.
type CdcEcmOutcome =
    completed
    | pressure
    | malformed
    | stalled
    | provider-lost
    | unsupported
    | timeout
    | cancelled
    | stale
    | sequence-exhausted
type CdcEcmControl = {
    result: UsbControlResult
    topology: Boolean
    mac: Boolean
    ack: Boolean
}
type CdcEcmRead = {
    ordinal: U64
    actual: U64
    short: Boolean
    gate: CdcEcmReceiveGate
}
type CdcEcmEvent =
    control CdcEcmControl
    | frame EthernetFrameResult
    | write UsbEndpointWriteResult
    | read CdcEcmRead
type CdcEcmStart = {
    terminator: UsbEndpointWriteRequest
}
type CdcEcmState = {
    terminator: UsbEndpointWriteRequest
    phase: U64
    cycles: U64
    transmitted: U64
    transmit: EthernetFrameResult
    receive: EthernetFrameRequest
    terminal: Boolean
    outcome: CdcEcmOutcome
}
type CdcEcmRoute =
    control CdcEcmState
    | frame CdcEcmState
    | write CdcEcmState
    | read CdcEcmState
    | stopped CdcEcmState
type CdcEcmPending =
    running CdcEcmState
    | stopped
type CdcEcmTransition = {
    previous: CdcEcmState
    event: CdcEcmEvent
    accepted: Boolean
}

# Class-owned Ethernet II admission on completed bulk transport observations.
# This pure adapter supplies no endpoint, network queue, address or authority.
# The reviewed ECM descriptor/control profile and independent network Root
# admission remain required before this adapter is installed in a class Plot.
# RX forwards identical bytes only under a direct checked length guard;
# metadata equality and Ethernet II header admission remain separate checks.

type CdcEcmReceiveGate =
    ready EthernetFrameRequest
    | malformed
    | stalled
    | provider-lost
    | unsupported
    | timeout

# Request one byte beyond the declared 1514-byte frame cap. Every legal frame
# must end short; a full completion cannot expose an oversized frame prefix.
# Short is relative to that request, with no private Rust class scheduler.

    seed: Empty...| <= 64B >> request: UsbEndpointReadRequest...| <= 4096B
) = ({ length: 1515 })

plot cdc-ecm-completed-frame (
    observed: UsbEndpointReadResult...| <= 4096B >> gate: CdcEcmReceiveGate...| <= 4096B
) = (. is completed ? (.completed.actual != bytes/length(.completed.wire) || bytes/length(.completed.wire) > 1514 || .completed.actual < 14 || !.completed.short ? malformed(empty) : ((bytes/at(.completed.wire, 6) & 1) != 0 || (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 6) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 7) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 8) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 9) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 10) == 0 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 11) == 0) ? malformed(empty) : (value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 12)) * 256 + value/u64(bytes/at(.completed.wire, 13)) < 1536 || (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 12) == 129 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 13) == 0) || (bytes/at(.completed.wire, 12) == 136 && bytes/at(.completed.wire, 13) == 168) ? malformed(empty) : ready(deliver-receive({ wire: .completed.wire }))))) : (. is stalled ? stalled(empty) : (. is provider-lost ? provider-lost(empty) : (. is timeout ? timeout(empty) : unsupported(empty)))))

# One physical placement per Kind. Drain queued TX before waiting for RX.
# A take-transmit pressure result means no queued frame in this sequential owner;
# it routes one RX rather than acknowledging or retrying the empty queue.
# TX and RX ordinals are independent, each bounded to sixteen actual frames.
# Other pressure/fault results terminate; full OUT and any ZLP precede its ack.
plot cdc-ecm-frame-service (
    >> start: CdcEcmStart <= 4096B
    observed: CdcEcmEvent...| <= 4096B >>
    ended: CdcEcmOutcome...| <= 512B >>
) {
    seed: flow/singleton
    terminal: flow/concat/finite
    cell: state/seeded/flow/until
    route: cdc-ecm-route()
    join: flow/zip/feedback
    controls: machine/usb/control
    frames: network/ethernet-frame
    writes: machine/usb/endpoint-write
    reads: machine/usb/endpoint-read
    first: flow/merge/finite
    second: flow/merge/finite
    events: flow/merge/finite
    start >> seed.value
    seed.flow >> cdc-ecm-start() >> cell.seed
    cell.current >> route
    route >> cdc-ecm-pending() >> select(CdcEcmPending.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.control, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-control-request() >> controls.request
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.frame, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-queue-request() >> frames.request
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.write, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-write-request() >> writes.request
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.read, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-read-request() >> reads.request
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.stopped, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-outcome() >> terminal.left
    route >> select(CdcEcmRoute.stopped, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-route() >> select(CdcEcmRoute.write, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-ecm-outcome() >> terminal.right
    # A stopped state routes to stopped again; the write selection closes empty.
    terminal.concatenated >> ended
    controls.result >> cdc-ecm-control-event() >> first.left
    frames.result >> cdc-ecm-frame-event() >> first.right
    writes.result >> cdc-ecm-write-event() >> second.left
    reads.result >> cdc-ecm-read-event() >> second.right
    first.merged >> events.left
    second.merged >> events.right
    events.merged >> join.right
    events.merged >> observed
    join.paired >> cdc-ecm-accept() >> cdc-ecm-advance() >> cell.next
}
